verdict.rationale: Missive's core product is built around shared inboxes/team channels with shared conversation state — docs describe assigning conversations to a team while maintaining visibility, multiple people working out of the same inbox without conflicts, shared address books, team spaces, and full action logging so everyone sees who did what. Distribution lists and shared inboxes are explicitly named as a core feature category, and this is corroborated by community reviews praising Missive specifically for team collaboration on shared accounts. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of real-time state sync under heavy concurrent load and no detailed documentation of exact conflict-resolution mechanics beyond marketing copy.
